title: Portal Warp UV Shader Between Two GLB Surfaces
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a portal warp UV shader system connecting two loaded GLB model surfaces. Load 'GlassHurricaneCandleHolder.glb' and 'DiffuseTransmissionTeacup.glb' using GLTFLoader from the Three.js examples CDN.

SCENE SETUP:
- Dark background (0x0a0a1a). PerspectiveCamera at (0, 2, 6) looking at origin.
- Ambient light (0x334466, 0.4) and a point light (0xaaccff, 1.5) at (3, 5, 3).
- Place the candle holder at position (-2.5, 0, 0) and the teacup at (2.5, 0, 0). Scale both models so they fit within a 2-unit bounding sphere each (normalize after load).
- Add a ground plane (10x10, dark material) at y=0.
- OrbitControls for camera.

PORTAL SHADER SYSTEM:
- Create a custom ShaderMaterial called 'portalMaterial' that implements a UV warp effect. The shader uses two render targets: one captures the view FROM the candle holder's surface looking outward, the other captures the view FROM the teacup's surface looking outward.
- The vertex shader passes UV coordinates and a 'vWorldPosition' varying.
- The fragment shader implements a swirl/warp distortion on UVs controlled by uniforms: u_warpStrength (float, default 0.0, range 0-2), u_warpRadius (float, default 0.5, range 0.1-1.0), u_time (float, auto-incremented), u_portalCenter (vec2, default 0.5,0.5), u_colorTint (vec3, default 0.3,0.6,1.0), u_blendFactor (float, default 0.5, range 0-1).
- The warp formula: offset angle = u_warpStrength * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, u_warpRadius, distance(uv, u_portalCenter))); rotated_uv = mat2(cos(angle), -sin(angle), sin(angle), cos(angle)) * (uv - u_portalCenter) + u_portalCenter;
- Apply portalMaterial to ALL meshes of BOTH models, replacing their original materials. The shader blends between the two render target textures using u_blendFactor.
- Add a pulsing glow ring (TorusGeometry) around each model that pulses with sin(u_time * 2) * 0.3 + 0.7 emissive intensity, colored by u_colorTint.

PORTAL LINK BEAM:
- Draw a visible beam (CylinderGeometry or custom line) connecting the two models' centers. The beam should have its own ShaderMaterial with a scrolling energy pattern (u_time based UV scroll). The beam opacity is tied to u_warpStrength / 2.0.

INTERACTION:
- Keyboard 'W'/'S': increase/decrease u_warpStrength by 0.1 (clamped 0-2).
- Keyboard 'R'/'F': increase/decrease u_warpRadius by 0.05 (clamped 0.1-1.0).
- Keyboard 'B'/'V': increase/decrease u_blendFactor by 0.1 (clamped 0-1).
- Keyboard 'T': cycle u_colorTint through 5 presets: blue(0.3,0.6,1.0), red(1.0,0.3,0.3), green(0.3,1.0,0.5), purple(0.7,0.3,1.0), gold(1.0,0.85,0.3). Track current index.
- Keyboard 'P': toggle pause/resume of u_time advancement. When paused, u_time freezes.
- Keyboard 'Z': undo last parameter change (maintain a history stack of up to 20 entries storing {warpStrength, warpRadius, blendFactor, colorTintIndex}).
- Keyboard 'Y': redo (if undo was performed and no new change since).
- Click on either model (raycasting): set u_portalCenter to the UV coordinate of the hit point. Update state.
- DOM button 'Reset All': reset all uniforms to defaults and clear history.

HUD (top-left, monospace, white on semi-transparent black):
- Line 1: 'Warp: {warpStrength.toFixed(2)} | Radius: {warpRadius.toFixed(2)}'
- Line 2: 'Blend: {blendFactor.toFixed(2)} | Tint: {tintName}'
- Line 3: 'Portal UV: ({portalCenter.x.toFixed(3)}, {portalCenter.y.toFixed(3)})'
- Line 4: 'Time: {time.toFixed(2)} | Paused: {paused}'
- Line 5: 'History: {historyLength}/{maxHistory} | Redo: {redoCount}'
- A 'Reset All' button below the HUD.

STATE MANAGEMENT - expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
{
  modelsLoaded: boolean (true when BOTH glbs loaded),
  candleHolderPosition: {x,y,z},
  teacupPosition: {x,y,z},
  warpStrength: number,
  warpRadius: number,
  blendFactor: number,
  colorTintIndex: number,
  colorTintName: string,
  colorTintRGB: {r,g,b},
  portalCenterU: number,
  portalCenterV: number,
  time: number,
  paused: boolean,
  beamOpacity: number,
  glowIntensity: number,
  historyLength: number,
  redoLength: number,
  maxHistory: 20,
  meshCount: number (total meshes with portal material applied),
  frameCount: number,
  lastAction: string (e.g. 'warp_up','undo','redo','reset','click_portal','tint_cycle','pause_toggle'),
  portalMaterialExists: boolean,
  beamMaterialExists: boolean
}
physics_constraints: All shader uniforms must remain within their clamped ranges at all times. u_warpStrength in [0,2], u_warpRadius in [0.1,1.0], u_blendFactor in [0,1]. Portal center UV must be in [0,1]x[0,1]. Beam opacity = warpStrength/2 clamped to [0,1]. Glow intensity = sin(time*2)*0.3+0.7 clamped to [0.4,1.0]. Undo/redo stack must be consistent: redo stack clears on any new action. Time must be monotonically non-decreasing (never goes backward). Color tint index must cycle modulo 5.
